title: 「What difference does it make whether / if…？」詢問會造成甚麼實際分別
titleZh: 「What difference does it make whether / if…？」詢問會造成甚麼實際分別
titleEn: Using “What difference does it make whether / if…?”

formula: What difference + does / did / will / would / can / could + it + make + whether / if + clause?

formulas.formula: What difference + does / did / will / would / can / could + it + make + whether / if + clause?

example: What difference does it make whether we leave now or later?
exampleZh: 我們現在還是稍後離開，究竟有甚麼分別？

examples.en: What difference does it make whether we leave now or later?
examples.zh: 我們現在還是稍後離開，究竟有甚麼分別？
examples.highlight: What difference does it make whether we leave now or later?

rules.zh: 通常用來提出兩個選擇我們現在還是稍後離開，有甚麼分別？ 會議在網上還是面對面舉行，有甚麼分別？ 常見形式：【whether + A + or + B；whether we go by bus or by train】 我們乘巴士還是火車 商店九時還是十時開門
rules.en: whether What difference does it make whether we leave now or later? What difference does it make whether the meeting is online or in person? whether + A + or + B whether we go by bus or by train whether the shop opens at nine or ten

rules.zh: 通常用來提出一個可能出現的條件；如果我們把活動移到室內，會有甚麼分別？ 如果送貨明天才到，會有甚麼分別？ 在【if】後面的內容通常表示：一個可能的改變；一個假設情況；一個尚未發生的條件。
rules.en: if What difference would it make if we moved the event indoors? What difference will it make if the delivery arrives tomorrow?

rules.zh: 直接問句 What difference does it make...? 必須使用疑問句語序：does 放在主語 it 前面，主要動詞 make 保持原形。
rules.en: What difference does it make whether we start now or later? does + it + make What difference it makes whether we start now or later?

rules.zh: 間接問句不使用倒裝直接問句：【What difference does it make whether we start now or later?】 間接問句：【I wonder what difference it makes whether we start now or later.】 正確：【what difference it makes】 錯誤：【what difference does it make】 因此：【I wonder what difference it makes whether we start now or later.】 我想知道我們現在還是稍後開始會有甚麼分別。
rules.en: What difference does it make whether we start now or later? I wonder what difference it makes whether we start now or later. what difference it makes what difference does it make I wonder what difference it makes whether we start now or later.

rules.zh: 時態和情態動詞會隨意思改變現在如果我們使用這個房間，有甚麼分別？ 過去他們提早還是遲到，當時有甚麼分別？ 將來如果送貨明天才到，會有甚麼分別？ 假設情況如果我們更改日期，會有甚麼分別？ 過去的假設情況如果我們當時早一點開始，又會有甚麼分別？
rules.en: What difference does it make if we use this room? What difference did it make whether they arrived early or late? What difference will it make if the delivery arrives tomorrow? What difference would it make if we changed the date? What difference would it have made if we had started earlier?

rules.zh: 人／結果是可選延伸，不是固定部分；核心句型已經完整：【What difference does it make whether we walk or take a taxi?】 我們步行還是乘的士，有甚麼分別？ 如需要說明「對誰」或「對甚麼結果」有影響，可以加入：【What difference does it make to you whether we walk or take a taxi?】 我們步行還是乘的士，對你有甚麼分別？ 如果我們更改這個數字，會對最終結果造成甚麼分別？
rules.en: to + What difference does it make whether we walk or take a taxi? What difference does it make to you whether we walk or take a taxi? What difference will it make to the final result if we change this number?

rules.zh: 這個句型可以放在不同位置放在句首放在另一個動詞後面放在較長句子的後半部分因此，what difference…並不一定要放在每句答案的最前面。
rules.en: What difference would it make if we changed the plan? Can you explain what difference it would make if we changed the plan? Before changing the plan, we need to know what difference it would make if we started earlier.

rules.zh: 這個問句有時帶有反問語氣這句可以是真正詢問分別，也可以暗示：其實根本沒有甚麼重要分別。因此，在較敏感的情況中，可以使用較柔和的間接問句：【I am not sure what difference it makes whether he wears a black shirt or a blue one.】 我不太明白他穿黑色還是藍色恤衫有甚麼分別。
rules.en: What difference does it make whether he wears a black shirt or a blue one? I am not sure what difference it makes whether he wears a black shirt or a blue one.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能幫助你詢問某個選擇是否真的會改變結果，而不只是詢問對方喜歡哪一個選擇。你較喜歡上午還是下午？ 我們在上午還是下午見面，會造成甚麼實際分別？ 第一句詢問喜好；第二句詢問實際影響。
benefits.en: It asks about the real effect of a choice This structure helps you ask whether a choice will actually change the result. Compare: Do you prefer the morning or the afternoon? What difference does it make whether we meet in the morning or the afternoon?

benefits.zh: 使用 whether…or…，可以把兩個選擇放在同一句中，讓比較關係更清楚。我們乘巴士還是火車，有甚麼分別？
benefits.en: It compares two choices in one clear sentence Using whether…or… allows you to place two choices in the same sentence. What difference does it make whether we travel by bus or by train?

benefits.zh: 使用 if，可以詢問某個可能或假設的改變會帶來甚麼影響。如果我們延長限期，會有甚麼分別？ 這在討論計劃、決定和解決方法時十分有用。
benefits.en: It helps you discuss possible changes Using if allows you to ask about the result of a possible or imagined change. What difference would it make if we extended the deadline?

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以用來詢問某個細節是否真的重要。文件夾是藍色還是綠色，究竟有甚麼分別？
benefits.en: It helps you question whether something is truly important This structure can politely or directly challenge the importance of a small detail. What difference does it make whether the folder is blue or green?

benefits.zh: 把 What difference does it make...? 放在 wonder、know、explain 或 see 等動詞後，可以把直接質問改成較柔和的間接問句。外層句式改變後，內層要使用陳述句語序，例如 I wonder what difference it makes...。
benefits.en: Embedded forms can make the question softer Instead of asking a direct question, you can place the expression after wonder, know, explain or see. Direct: What difference does it make whether we start now or later? Softer: I wonder what difference it makes whether we start now or later.

benefits.zh: 這個句型為討論不同計劃、規則、服務和可能改變提供一個實用句框：【What difference would it make if __________?】
benefits.en: It gives you a useful frame for discussions The structure provides a ready-made frame for comparing plans, rules, services and possible changes. What difference would it make if __________? Can you explain what difference it makes whether __________ or __________?

en: Rewrite each sentence using an appropriate form of:
what difference + make + whether / if + clause
Use a direct or embedded question according to the original meaning.
Preserve the original tense, modality, people, choices and results.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用以下句型的適當形式改寫句子：
what difference + make + whether / if + 子句
請按照原句意思，使用直接問句或間接問句。
請保留原句的時態、語氣、人物、選擇和結果。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。
